# Frozen Ward v1 integration bundle

These files are the byte-for-byte output of the pre-v2 installer at commit
`2c9905248514629035e801e802c093a88b0d020d` (`feat: add Ward veto-only security
guardrail`), generated with the fixed home
`/private/tmp/ward-frozen-v1-home`. `original-*` are the exact host inputs used
for uninstall restoration checks. Do not regenerate them with the current
encoder.
